summary: Backend + frontend regression after new declaration schema (acilis/kapanis, ithalatci, gumruk, ibkb/destek) and same-currency match rule. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for new schema; 31/31 pytest pass (auth, RBAC on declarations/payments/matches/users, same-currency kur=1 AYNI_DOVIZ, cross-currency TCMB, over-declaration/over-payment errors, update/delete match recalc, block-delete when matched, dashboard, audit logs, reports summary with ithalatci/ibkb_alinmadi/destek_alinmadi, Excel export with new columns, users admin-only). Frontend verified live at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: new declaration form with all new fields + live %3 destek preview (300,00 EUR for 10.000 EUR); son_kapatma date correctly = kapanis+180 (2026-03-15 → 11.09.2026); IBKB/destek badges show ALINMADI; filter-ibkb & filter-destek narrow list correctly; search matches ithalatci/gumruk; MatchDialog same-currency (EUR/EUR) does NOT render match-rate-input and shows 'Aynı döviz ... kur kullanılmaz' info, saves match with kur=1 AYNI_DOVIZ, amount saved 1:1; cross-currency (EUR/USD) renders rate input with TCMB rate 0.858744 fetched automatically and 'Bedelden düşecek' preview computed; Reports page shows report-currency-table, report-importer-table, report-ibkb-missing, report-destek-missing; export-excel-button present; RBAC verified (banka/sef cannot see add-declaration).

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout (playbook expects 5-fail temp block).
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — cookie clients rejected by browsers; Bearer fallback is used.

ui_bugs.issue: DialogDescription still references removed field: renders 'GB tescil tarihi ()' because it uses declaration.tescil_tarihi which no longer exists. Should be declaration.acilis_tarihi.

action_items: Fix MatchDialog.js L135: replace declaration.tescil_tarihi with declaration.acilis_tarihi so the header shows the correct kur date.
critical_code_review_comments: MatchDialog.js still shows 'GB tescil tarihi ({fmtDate(declaration.tescil_tarihi)})' — leftover from old schema; label + variable both need renaming to 'Beyanname açılış tarihi' / acilis_tarihi.
server.py create_match: when same currency the passed body.kur is silently overridden to 1.0 — good behavior but consider returning 400 if caller sends a non-1 kur, to avoid confusion.
server.py declaration_view: son_kapatma_tarihi silently becomes '' on unparseable dates; consider validating acilis_tarihi format on input.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested assertions (rate hidden for same-cur, TCMB auto for cross-cur, %3 destek, son_kapatma=+180, filters, reports, RBAC)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral UI_TEST_* declaration + EUR/USD payments created and cleaned up via API at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now uses the new schema (acilis_tarihi, kapanis_tarihi, ithalatci, gumruk_mudurlugu_no, ibkb_alindi, destek_alindi). GET /api/users is admin-only. In matches, same-currency call must NOT send kur (or send kur ignored -> kur=1 AYNI_DOVIZ). Cross-currency uses TCMB automatically when kur omitted. Reports summary returns ithalatci list + ibkb_alinmadi + destek_alinmadi counters. Excel export has 15 headers including 'Son Kapatma Tarihi (180 gün)', 'IBKB Belgesi', 'Destek Ödemesi (%3)', 'Destek Durumu'. Frontend public URL: https://trade-settlement-pro.preview.emergentagent.com
rca_of_the_issue: MatchDialog leftover uses declaration.tescil_tarihi (undefined in new schema) so the dialog header shows an empty date. Purely cosmetic; core match flow unaffected.
